reason: I'm about to start the migration I've been dodging for a year, and it's free and runs offline, so one afternoon pointing it at a client app before and after costs me nothing but time. If it shows me a diff my tests missed, it stays; if it buries me in noise, it's gone the same day.
objection: My tests already catch regressions, and every 'AI' tool I've tried looked great on its own demo invoice and fell apart on my messy client code. I expect false diffs from dates, ordering and session state, and I won't spend a week tuning masks for something that's supposed to save me time.
would_change_my_mind: If the first run on my own app gives me a pile of false differences or needs more than an hour of setup, I drop it.
